key_evidence_spans: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules present on the central face and around the eyes, with similar papules noted on the vulva.
Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
Clefting between tumor aggregates and the surrounding stroma was focally evident.
No palmar or plantar pits were observed.
Radiographic studies did not reveal any jaw cysts.

Whole-exome sequencing revealed:    - A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples    - Additional distinct deletions of the trans SUFU allele in all tumor samples    - No deletions present in the normal sample
